entry.title: Meissel's theorem in additive arithmetical semigroups
entry.summary: We show how to control the error term in Mertens' formula and related theorems in the context of additive arithmetical semigroups and carry over an old related result of Meissel.

entry.title: Asymptotics of the counting function of $k$-th power-free elements in an arithmetic semigroup
entry.summary: For any $k>1$, we find the asymptotics of the counting function of $k$-th power-free elements in an additive arithmetic semigroup with exponential growth of the abstract prime counting function. This paper continues the authors' earlier research dealing with the case of infinite $k$.

entry.title: Dynamics on the number of prime divisors for additive arithmetic semigroups
entry.summary: In 2020, Bergelson and Richter gave a dynamical generalization of the classical Prime Number Theorem, which has been generalized by Loyd in a disjoint form with the Erdős-Kac Theorem. These generalizations reveal the rich ergodic properties of the number of prime divisors of integers. In this article, we show a new generalization of Bergelson and Richter's Theorem in a disjoint form with the distribution of the largest prime factors of integers. Then following Bergelson and Richter's techniques, we will show the analogues of all of these results for the arithmetic semigroups arising from finite fields as well.
entry.arxiv:comment: 19 pages. To appear in Finite Fields and Their Applications

entry.title: Asymptotic Expansion of Warlimont Functions on Wright Semigroups
entry.summary: We calculate full asymptotic expansions of prime-independent multiplicative functions on additive arithmetic semigroups that satisfy a strong form of Knopfmacher's axioms. When applied to the semigroup of unlabeled graphs, our method yields detailed asymptotic information on how graphs decompose into connected components. As a second class of examples, we discuss polynomials in several variables over a finite field.
